messages:
sara_support: FYI ticket #C-8421 — customer says their invoice never moved to 'paid' even though they uploaded a valid resale certificate and provided a PO. They tried a corporate card and it was declined. Can someone look?

michael_billing: Pulling the invoice now. I see status=held_for_tax_info and payment_attempts=1 with latest error: `402 card_declined - billing_name_mismatch`. Customer company name on PO: 'GreenEdge Logistics GmbH'. VAT ID on cert: DE123456789. Billing profile name: GreenEdge Logistics Ltd (UK).

alexa_eng: @michael_billing can you paste the invoice metadata JSON? want to repro how cert->exemption flow failed.

michael_billing: snippet: ```{"invoice_id":"inv_8Xy9","customer_id":"cus_ggL","po_reference":"GE-PO-998","billing_profile":{"name":"GreenEdge Logistics Ltd","country":"GB","vat_id":null},"tax_handling":"auto","tax_docs":[{"type":"resale_certificate","status":"accepted","vat_id":"DE123456789"}]}``` The system didn't map the DE VAT to the GB billing profile so exemption flag wasn't set.

ida_legal: Important: for reverse charge we need matching legal entity name + VAT country alignment. If the PO is tied to a UK entity but the certificate is DE (different legal entity), we require additional proof. Do we have an uploaded corporate registration or cross-entity agreement?

tony_account_mgr: Customer claims they operate both DE and UK entities and expected us to apply reverse charge based on the DE VAT. They supplied a PO referencing a UK billing account because their procurement team is centralized. We need to confirm whether we can accept cross-entity resale certs.

alexa_eng: For repro: I can run a test on staging: create customer with billing_profile.name=GreenEdge Logistics Ltd (GB) and attach resale_certificate with vat_id=DE123456789 and country=DE, then run POST /billing/invoices/generate. If our mapping uses profile.country for exemption decision, this will reproduce. Can someone give me the exact steps and any middleware logs?

billing-bot: deploy:billing-service staging logs available at https://logs.internal/r/2024/06/27/bs-371. Matching correlation_id: a1b2c3-inv_8Xy9.

michael_billing: Repro steps I used locally: 1) create customer via `POST /v1/customers` with name + billing_profile.country=GB 2) attach tax doc via `POST /v1/customers/:id/tax_docs` with `{type:resale_certificate,vat_id:DE123456789,country:DE}` 3) `POST /v1/invoices` -> invoice returned tax_status=not_exempt. Logs show call to VIES returned `valid:true name_mismatch:true`.

alexa_eng: Good — so VIES says VAT ID valid but name mismatch. Our exemption logic currently requires either exact name match or explicit `allow_name_variance` flag on account. Suggest two short-term options: (A) support can manually override tax_status on invoice to exempt and reattempt charge; (B) finance/legal request additional docs (company registration) and then we mark account cross-entity.

ida_legal: Prefer (B) for compliance, but can approve manual override in urgent cases if we store evidence and a ticked audit trail.

tony_account_mgr: Customer is blocked from launching product next week; they want a manual override so they can get the reverse charge on file. I'll push for override and gather company registration docs today.

alexa_eng: I'll create a staging repro playbook: commands + expected payloads and attach logs. @michael_billing can you do the manual override once legal confirms? Steps: `PATCH /v1/invoices/inv_8Xy9` `{tax_status:exempt,exemption_reason:\"manual_corp_override\",audit_evidence_id:\"evidence_843\"}`. Then `POST /v1/payments` to retry.

michael_billing: Will do once legal posts confirmation here. Also noting payment retry might still fail if card processor rejects on billing name mismatch — we'll need cardholder name update or use bank transfer.

sara_support: Action items: 1) tony to gather corp registration + note from procurement (by EOD) 2) ida to confirm manual override criteria 3) michael to hold a payment retry slot after override 4) alexa to push repro playbook and staging test. I'll update ticket and set expectation. :thumbsup:
